components: Conditional on a signed-neutrality filter, compare common, independent and unrestricted collision alternatives at fixed arity on both sheets.
candidates.declared_status: Some small-body interactions conserve both block counts separately; allowing a nontrivial signed conversion costs additional packets and depends on operation locality.
missing_bridges: Select a collision mechanism without filtering on the very quantity to be explained.

components: Solve additive conservation from reversible within-block, interpacket and seven ternary channel templates before comparing to signed ballot. Track controls, synchronized moves and operational reachability.
candidates.declared_status: One template in this retrospectively chosen grammar reproduces the ballot up to normalization; combined alternatives erase every nonconstant additive invariant.
missing_bridges: Explain supply of two blank packets, synchronized channel choice and firing. Distinguish absolute versus relative preparations out of grammar.

components: Search chord reflections of all sixteen endpoint readings without specifying a root list. Compare signed equal-weight flags with pair-product flags and compare full, blank and ballot stabilizers.
candidates.declared_status: The D5, A4 and A2 plus A1 reflection patterns are finite and metric-dependent, not gauge fields or a Standard Model derivation.
missing_bridges: Derive a physical metric, continuous local interactions and a reason to remove the extra Abelian axis.

components: Check the discriminant form, minimal rank of an even positive unimodular enlargement and root counts of explicit E8 and rank-sixteen completions under D5 projections.
candidates.declared_status: Exact lattice identities under extra assumptions; the E8 construction supplies four copies of each spinor chirality in this projection, not three generations.
missing_bridges: Derive any even unimodular requirement, physical compactification, particle identification and selection of an embedding.

components: Equal-weight traces of the two-block flags, a weighted-metric control, direct pole asymmetry sign and one-loop complete-family shifts under standard external gauge assumptions.
candidates.declared_status: A normalized generator is not a coupling. The naive effective-pole dictionary has the wrong sign; complete families cancel from one-loop slope differences.
missing_bridges: Provide a physical coupling metric, running and thresholds and a genuinely independent generation-selecting observable.
